readArtifacts: stardust/current/pages/*.json (99 records; 6 redirects excluded from cross-page tables)
notes: Census logo (aggregate.logo) picked header_logo_bounce.webp (a P&G sibling-brand icon in the top bar, not in the home link). Overridden with the header logo a.header-logo img → /images/brand_main_logo.svg (census logoCandidates selector "#site-header > div:nth-of-type(2) > div > div > div > a > img", rect 71×111 at 1440).

Palette capped at 8. Dropped by weight: #808080 (226, table borders on research articles), #ffb89c (214, peach step-timeline marks/backgrounds), #4d4d4d (62, click2cart widget text), #000000 (56, accessibility.pg.com + click2cart), #003da7 (42, accessibility.pg.com only), #f2f2f2 (34), #4163f7 (32, click2cart dialog link), #fee500 (28, yellow carousel dot borders), #003e29, #c1c1c1, #0071dc/#cd2027 (Walmart/Target retailer logos in click2cart), #14789f, #50aded, #4e5bb4, #fc7844, #ed8e69, #00269a (2), #102086, #abe1fa.

Off-origin evidence: the census includes https://accessibility.pg.com/en-US/ (the redirect target of /en-us/accessibility). Its Montserrat headings (17) and #003da7 text are P&G, not Tide, and are excluded from type families and palette roles.

Third-party widget evidence: the 8 click2cart pages render a SmartCommerce Angular widget (Poppins, FontAwesome, rgba(0,0,0,.4) shadow, 5px/45px radii). Kept in the frequency tables as observed but not used for any brand role.

Radius divergence: count-mode is 25px (622, pill buttons/chips); area-mode is 8px (316 elements, largest area — cards/white boxes). Home agrees with cross-page (25px buttons, 8px cards). No home-vs-cross-page divergence.

Declared tokens: only --color_orange:#fb4c06 and --color_blue:#00269a (93 pages, inline custom props). --color_blue does not match the dominant navy text (#1b3392, ΔE 14.6); it clusters with #13259c (ΔE 2.1).

@font-face rules for MontserratRegular/Medium/Bold/ExtraBold/Black, Anton and IntroScriptDemo are declared in 0x8blnfnms9hr.css but no captured tide.com element renders them (census fonts[].status "unloaded"; aggregate.type.families has no such family on tide.com). Anton is referenced by legacy .page-header/.big-header rules.

heroImage: the home hero is a 2-slide react-multi-carousel; the first slide image is 1920×500 intrinsic (aspect 3.84, outside the [0.3,3.0] filter by intrinsic size). No per-image rect was captured, so the capture's own slots.lead-image is elevated; rendered crop is not measured.
Background-motif detection: cssBackgrounds reuse ≥2 pages only occurs on redirect pages (ytimg thumbnail of the Loads of Hope video); none on canonical pages → no background-motif system component.

containerMaxWidth taken from CSS (.container max-width 1170px @min-width:1200px, 15px gutters → 1140px content, matches measured nav width 1140 at 1440). Cap-probe (extensions.breakpoints) not yet run.
